final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), mn AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - mn.mean_rate AS diff_from_mean FROM r, mn WHERE r.rate > mn.mean_rate
